page_title: PSG 2-2 REI | PSG v Reims 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 47900.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Yehvann Diouf.
88' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but Yehvann Diouf punches the ball away.
88' PSG take a short corner kick.
87' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
84' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
83' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Junya Ito will be replaced by Benjamin Stambouli (Reims).
83' Substitution. Reda Khadra (Reims) in, Teddy Teuma out.
79' Kang-In Lee (PSG) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
79' Yellow card. Junya Ito (Reims) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
77' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Yehvann Diouf.
75' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
73' Substitution. Carlos Soler makes his way off the pitch and Ousmane Dembele (PSG) comes on as his replacement.
73' Goncalo Ramos will be replaced by Kylian Mbappe (PSG).
72' That will be all from Valentin Atangana Edoa who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Amir Richardson (Reims).
70' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Danilo Pereira is replaced by Nuno Mendes (PSG).
69' Substitution. Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) on for Bradley Barcola.
66' Oumar Diakite (Reims) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

65' Carlos Soler (PSG) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
64' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
64' Kang-In Lee (PSG) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
62' A great solo run by Oumar Diakite (Reims) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the left side of the goal was easily caught by Keylor Navas.
59' Substitution. Sergio Akieme (Reims) replaces Thibault De Smet.

59' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
59' Corner kick. Reims will have an opportunity.

58' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Reims will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' Referee Willy Delajod has finally had enough of Will Still and brandishes a yellow card at him!
54' It must be a yellow card. It is. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
53' Close! Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
52' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
51' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
49' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Willy Delajod signals.
46' Bradley Barcola (PSG) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
46' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Rough tackle by Carlos Soler (PSG). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Thibault De Smet (Reims). Willy Delajod saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PSG get a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 2 Goal! Emmanuel Agbadou displays great vision and sends a pass to Oumar Diakite (Reims), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:2.
45' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Reims.
43' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' The game is interrupted now, Manuel Ugarte (PSG) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
41' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
41' A poor mid-range free-kick by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
39' Thibault De Smet (Reims) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
38' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
38' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) picks up a long through ball, but Yehvann Diouf deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
35' Junya Ito (Reims) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
33' Teddy Teuma (Reims) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
31' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared by the defence.

31' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Yehvann Diouf has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
30' Kang-In Lee (PSG) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
28' Achraf Hakimi almost found himself in a promising position after Kang-In Lee (PSG) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
25' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
24' The free kick is taken by Kang-In Lee (PSG), but ball is cleared.
24' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. PSG will take a free kick.
19' 2 - 1 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.

17' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
17' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
16' Wow, what an escape. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. PSG will take a corner kick.
15' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
14' Poor challenge! Oumar Diakite (Reims) is penalised for tripping and Willy Delajod blows his whistle.
13' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

12' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.

12' He should have scored! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Yehvann Diouf makes an easy save.
11' Kang-In Lee (PSG) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
10' Bradley Barcola (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Oumar Diakite feeds Marshall Munetsi (Reims), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
6' Kang-In Lee floats a good corner into the box that Danilo Pereira (PSG) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the right post.
5' Corner kick. Kang-In Lee (PSG) is ready to send the ball into the box.
5' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Now PSG have a corner.

4' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has started.
Reims will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
